Dear Distribuciones Sanitarias del Norte S.A.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice N-77002 (INV-0007) and our purchase order PO-0002.

We have identified the following difference:

SKU MASK-IIR: The unit price on the invoice is 3.40 EUR, whereas the agreed price on the purchase order is 3.00 EUR. This represents an overcharge of 0.40 EUR per unit, resulting in a total amount in dispute of 20.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice reflecting the agreed price of 3.00 EUR per unit, or issue a credit note for 20.00 EUR to resolve this matter.

Please advise on how you would like to proceed.

Best regards

Dear Material Clinico Levante S.L.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice LV-0303 (INV-0008) and our purchase order PO-0003.

Upon receipt and verification of the goods, we identified the following difference:

SKU GAUZE-NS-5: Quantity discrepancy - we expected 40.0 units but received only 35.0 units, resulting in a shortage of 25.00 EUR.

The total amount in dispute is 0.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note to resolve this matter.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this issue.

Best regards

Dear Suministros Medicos Iberia S.L.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice F-2026-1004 (INV-0009) and our purchase order PO-0004.

Our records indicate the following difference:

- ALC70-500: 10.00 EUR (extra line item with 5 units at 2.00 EUR per unit)

The total amount in dispute is 10.00 EUR.

This item was not included in our original purchase order and should not have been invoiced. We request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note for the amount of 10.00 EUR.

Please advise on how you would like to proceed.

Best regards

Dear Distribuciones Sanitarias del Norte S.A.,

We are writing to bring to your attention discrepancies between invoice N-77005 (INV-0010) and our purchase order PO-0005.

The following differences have been identified:

- SAL-250: An extra line item has been invoiced for 108.00 EUR (60 units at 1.80 EUR per unit). This item was not included in the purchase order.

- SAL-500: A line item for 108.00 EUR (60 units at 1.80 EUR per unit) is missing from the invoice. This item was specified in the purchase order.

The total amount in dispute is 108.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note to resolve these discrepancies.

Please contact us if you require any further information.

Best regards
